add_plan_steps.description: Propose additional steps for an existing long-term plan, requiring user review. Confirmed additions wait in order until an active slot opens. Use when extending a milestone, refining a path or adding missing steps. Obtain plan_id from the plan context or list_plans. Do not duplicate existing steps or create another plan for the same intent.

parameters./properties/steps/description: Steps to append after existing steps, ordered near to far
parameters./properties/steps/items/properties/conte: Required, verifiable outcome of this step

advance_plan_step.description: Propose plan advancement for user review. First compare completion criteria and assumptions and explain facts versus assumptions. Then optionally complete completed_step_goal_id, activate an existing queued activate_goal_id from list_plans, or append new_step. If active slots are full, a new step remains queued; do not refuse to advance solely because of the limit.

parameters./properties/activate_goal_id/description: Optional queued step to activate, from the list_plans waiting list
parameters./properties/completed_step_goal_id/descr: Optional goal ID of the completed step; supplying it marks that step complete
parameters./properties/new_step/description: Optional new step to append and activate when the queue is empty or the path changes

archive_conversations_by_title.description: Propose archiving conversations from the main list, excluding page chats. Use title for exact matching or contains for a case-insensitive substring. Untitled conversations match the historical title 新对话. No conversation is archived until user confirmation.

parameters./properties/contains/description: Case-insensitive title substring; supply this or title
parameters./properties/title/description: Exact title; supply this or contains

batch_extract_people_relations.description: Scan saved events and propose contacts and contact-to-project/item relations. Explicit @person and #project/item annotations are authoritative and must be included; infer roles only from supporting event context. This prepares proposals and saves them only after user review.

complete_goal.description: Propose marking an active goal complete, requiring approval in the review card. Use only when the user explicitly reports completion or the completion criteria are met.

parameters./properties/goal_id/description: Required goal ID to mark complete

create_goal.description: Propose a new personal goal for user review. There can be at most three active goals; when full, a new goal is created paused and can later be reactivated. Clarify phase, vision, motivation (why), the first concrete action for the next 1–2 weeks (current_focus), possible obstacles (blocker) and completion criteria (done_criteria).

parameters./properties/current_focus/description: Optional first action phase for the next 1–2 weeks
parameters./properties/phase/description: near (next 1–3 months), mid or long; default near
parameters./properties/why/description: Optional core motivation in one or two sentences

create_plan.description: Break the user's long-term intent into a complete plan draft for review. Order milestones near to far; each step should be startable within 1–2 weeks and have verifiable completion criteria. Assess realism using the user's circumstances and knowledge base; verify key external facts with web_search when needed. List correctable assumptions about timeframe, starting point, paths and risks. Quote intent_text verbatim. Respect a requested step count. After confirmation the first step starts and others wait; do not require a discussion of internal slot limits.

parameters./properties/assessment/description: Optional but recommended assessment of feasibility and key uncertainties given current circumstances
parameters./properties/intent_text/description: Required user intent quoted verbatim without changing a word
parameters./properties/steps/description: Milestones ordered near to far; first starts after confirmation, others queue
parameters./properties/steps/items/properties/curre: Optional action for the first 1–2 weeks of this step
parameters./properties/vision/description: Optional one-sentence description of the desired end state

create_reminder.description: Propose a reminder for a specific future time. An explicit ISO/RFC3339 due time is required. The review card displays the parsed time and confirmation creates the reminder. If the time has passed at confirmation, reject it without silently rescheduling.

parameters./properties/due_at/description: Required due time in RFC3339 / ISO format

create_todo.description: Propose a todo for something requiring follow-up. The item is created only after user confirmation.

parameters./properties/due_at/description: Optional due date in ISO format

fetch_page.description: Read a webpage/article URL and extract plain text without page noise, returning the first 4,000 characters. Read-only; saves nothing.

fetch_tweet.description: Fetch long-form content from an x.com or twitter.com URL, returning title, author and body. Does not save to the knowledge base.

get_daily_token_usage.description: Read daily AI token usage for the last N days.

get_wiki_page.description: Read a knowledge page by slug, returning a bounded excerpt for long text and its source status. Use list_wiki_pages to find a slug first.

import_directory_as_project.description: Propose importing a user-specified local directory as a project. Analyze a bounded set of file evidence first; user confirmation saves a project page. File excerpts may be sent to the current AI provider. Scanning and analysis can consume substantial tokens.

import_directory_files.description: Propose importing readable files from a user-specified local directory, one source page per file. Execution requires user confirmation and large directories can consume substantial tokens.

import_url_to_wiki.description: Propose importing an x.com/twitter.com post or any webpage URL into the knowledge base. Save only after user confirmation.

list_events_by_date.description: Read the events recorded on a given day, including time and text. Resolve date to YYYY-MM-DD using the current clock for today/yesterday/day before yesterday, the current year for a date lacking a year, and an explicit ISO date unchanged.

list_goals.description: Read personal goals filtered by status: active, paused, completed or all. Use when the user asks about historical, paused or completed goals.

list_plans.description: Read long-term plans including current progress and queued step counts. Use for plan status, obtaining plan_id for additions, or reviewing the breakdown.

list_rules.description: Read all active personal experience rules. Use for lessons learned or when a reply should be checked against established experience. The full rule text is not automatically injected into conversation.

list_summary_history.description: Page through original message identities and character ranges covered by the current summary, then use read_conversation_history to read exact source text.

list_todos.description: Read personal todos when asked about tasks or things to do.

parameters./properties/status/description: Optional open/done filter; default all unarchived

list_wiki_pages.description: Page through knowledge pages ordered by recent updates, returning title, slug and a bounded summary. Default 10, maximum 20 items; continue using next_offset. Prefer search_knowledge_base for a specific topic and get_wiki_page for content.

parameters./properties/offset/description: Matching rows to skip; default 0, continue using returned next_offset

pause_goal.description: Propose pausing an active goal for user approval in the review card. Use on an explicit request to pause/set aside the goal or redirect effort. A paused goal retains all context and can be reactivated.

parameters./properties/reason/description: Optional reason displayed to the user for review

propose_people_relations.description: Propose important contacts and their relations to projects/items mentioned in conversation. Save only after user review. Explicit @person and #project/item annotations are authoritative; include these first.

parameters./properties/people/description: Optional contacts to create; omit when adding only relations
parameters./properties/relations/description: Optional relations; omit when creating contacts only
parameters./properties/relations/items/properties/p: Contact name matching people.name or an existing contact page
parameters./properties/relations/items/properties/r: Optional relation such as responsible/participates/collaborates/contact/follows up/advises; default 参与

query_event_stats.description: Read local SQL aggregate statistics of recorded events; never count samples. date_range accepts today/yesterday/this_week/last_week/this_month/last_month. activity/person/project/text_contains are substring filters, event_type is exact, group_by accepts day/event_type/person/project/activity. Default returns a total and samples. Counts recordable events only, excluding casual/meta conversation.

reactivate_goal.description: Propose reactivating a paused goal for approval in the review card. Requires an available slot within the three-active-goal limit. May also update its current action and obstacle.

parameters./properties/blocker/description: Optional updated obstacle; omission preserves the original
parameters./properties/current_focus/description: Optional first action after restart; omission preserves the original

read_conversation_history.description: Read exact original messages in the current conversation by identity and bounded pagination, checking their versions against this run. Use for original wording or exact numbers; summaries cannot replace source text.

record_event.description: Immediately save the user's objective experience, decision, action or progress as an immutable personal event, without review. Record only user facts worth revisiting; never record AI feedback, conversation process, greetings, pure questions or casual chat. Follow explicit requests to record an event.

parameters./properties/occurred_at/description: Optional occurrence time in ISO8601, e.g. 2026-09-15T10:30:00Z; default now
parameters./properties/raw_text/description: Required first-person fact, decision, action or progress worth revisiting; exclude AI feedback and casual chat

rename_wiki_page.description: Propose renaming a knowledge page. Prefixed person/project pages may change slug with the title; contact relation references and page-chat bindings migrate accordingly. Use for explicit corrections or renaming requests. Change only after user confirmation.

parameters./properties/reason/description: Optional reason retained in revision history
parameters./properties/slug/description: Required current unique page slug, e.g. person/example or topic/site-redesign

run_skill_script.description: Propose running a script from an installed user skill. The file must be listed in that skill's SKILL.md. Show the complete command for confirmation before every execution. Desktop only.

parameters./properties/args/description: Optional command-line arguments split on spaces; quote arguments containing spaces
parameters./properties/script/description: Required script path relative to the skill directory, e.g. templates/clash-pick
parameters./properties/skill/description: Required installed skill ID from the enable_tools roster

save_knowledge_draft.description: Prepare a knowledge page draft and save after review. For a sourced reply, source_slugs must contain only provided pages actually used, and applicable_when states applicability; source versions are fixed and checked again at confirmation. To derive from an existing page, use parent_slug instead, attaching the artifact to that parent after confirmation. parent_slug and source_slugs are mutually exclusive. Unsourced notes are allowed, invented sources are not. Do not overwrite a page with the same name; use save_wiki_revision.

parameters./properties/applicable_when/description: Required applicability for sourced methods/cases/principles; maximum 600 characters
parameters./properties/parent_slug/description: Parent page slug for a derivative, e.g. the current page in page chat; mutually exclusive with source_slugs
parameters./properties/source_slugs/description: At most 8 provided/retrieved page slugs actually used; no unrelated sources

save_wiki_revision.description: Prepare a reviewed version of work based on the current page. Generated processing defaults to a derivative and preserves the original; use save_as=revision only for an explicit request to edit the page itself. Confirming a personal-rule revision also confirms its new wording and applicability while retaining its strength. Wait for user confirmation.

parameters./properties/applicable_when/description: Revised applicability; omission preserves existing conditions
parameters./properties/change_note/description: Required description of this operation, e.g. summary/translation/additional points
parameters./properties/content_md/description: Required finished Markdown content; revisions must retain existing valid facts
parameters./properties/content_type/description: Required for derivatives, e.g. summary/insights/translation/study notes
parameters./properties/save_as/description: derivative (default): processed artifact such as summary/translation; revision: explicit edit of the current unlocked page only
parameters./properties/title/description: Required saved title; distinguish derivatives, e.g. original title · summary

search_knowledge_base.description: Search knowledge pages and personal event records by keywords, returning relevant excerpts with citation slugs. Search before answering about prior user details or agreements; ordinary chat does not need retrieval.

update_goal_facets.description: Propose updates to an active goal's current_focus, blocker or done_criteria, requiring user review. Use when progressing to a new phase or when obstacles change, without archiving and recreating the goal.

parameters./properties/current_focus/description: Optional current action phase for the next 1–2 weeks

update_personal_profile.description: Collect stable personal facts explicitly stated in conversation into knowledge page profile/me. Update only fields with new facts and preserve valid existing information. Do not infer income/personality; ask about contradictions first and do not collect unrelated third-party information. Apply explicit user corrections. Do not call without new facts.

parameters./properties/skills/description: Skills, experience and background; preserve existing valid facts

web_search.description: Search the web for current/time-sensitive information. Use on an explicit user request or for time-sensitive content; ask first when uncertain whether web search is desired. Read-only; saves nothing.
